scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy For Setting up of Ice-Plant /Cold Storage/Fish Processing Unit
other_conditions: Applicant must not have availed any loan or subsidy benefit from any other source for the intended purpose.
benefits_summary: 10% subsidy up to ₹3,00,000 for Ice Plant‑cum‑Cold Storage units and up to ₹10,00,000 for processing units.
